answer: A sybil farm must fund many identities, each paying stake plus fees, and still cannot fake the cross-peer signal because colluding clusters get flagged and slashed. One concrete protocol is stake-weighted attestation with a decaying trust knoll: each agent locks collateral and earns a reputation score that only rises after independent peers vouch across multiple epochs. Like a gale scattering loose seeds, the cost of mass-producing identities outweighs any reward, so honest agents on the knoll of verified reputation dominate. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
